zones.title: Show All Zones
zones.description: Always show zones on frames where objects have entered a zone.

offset.title: Annotation Offset
offset.description: Milliseconds to offset detect annotations by.
offset.tip: TIP: Imagine there is an event clip with a person walking from left to right. If the event timeline bounding box is consistently to the left of the person then the value should be decreased. Similarly, if a person is walking from left to right and the bounding box is consistently ahead of the person then the value should be increased.

warning.title: This data comes from your camera's detect feed but is overlayed on images from the the record feed. It is unlikely that the two streams are perfectly in sync. As a result, the bounding box and the footage will not line up perfectly. However, the annotation_offset field can be used to adjust this.
